brain.commentary: Neutral risk posture. The cross-asset regime is risk-on, but conviction and composite scores are only marginally positive, institutional advisory risk is elevated, and downside expected shortfall is material for BTC, ETH, and SOL. BTC is the strongest observable signal but does not warrant an aggressive overlay. ETH and especially SOL are fragile due to negative alpha, higher beta/volatility, and weaker liquidity. LTC is fragile and appropriately flat. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are all fragile because their identical signals and zero volatility/expected-shortfall input
